verdict.rationale: Docusign CLM explicitly offers configurable workflow-building (drag-and-drop process design, conditional rules for review of non-standard terms) and eSignature also touts 'configurable workflows,' supporting approval routing before signature. However, evidence is largely marketing copy without concrete detail on approval-chain configuration, sequencing, or escalation logic, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of this specific workflow-approval feature exists in the community evidence. Missing for 10: hands-on or third-party validation of approval workflow configuration, technical documentation detail on approval routing logic, and evidence of legal-ops-specific customization.
